XY series · EVO

Evolutions

Released November 2, 2016 · 113 cards

Expanded

Evolutions is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the XY series, released in English on November 2, 2016. Its main set has 108 cards, plus 5 secret rares numbered beyond the set (113 in total). It includes 83 Pokémon, 20 Trainer and 10 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

14 illustrators worked on Evolutions. Most cards: Ken Sugimori (34), Keiji Kinebuchi (21), 5ban Graphics (18), Mitsuhiro Arita (14), Eske Yoshinob (4), Ryo Ueda (3), Ayaka Yoshida (2), Toshinao Aoki (2).
